hooks.text: 满足条件并消耗Truth Crystals可定向制作想要的牌，还能用Super Card替换不想入牌组的卡
hooks.excerpt: Meet the requirements, spend Truth Crystals, and craft the card you want. Don’t want one card to appear in your deck...? Replace it with one of your super cards !
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 抽取Fate Cards后可把事件排进时间线，预先设计女巫将经历的路线与意外转折
hooks.excerpt: You can customize the events the witches will encounter by drawing a certain number of Fate Cards on the map interface and arranging them along the timeline according to your will. Once the route is set, the witches will follow your planned course, and some ingenious combinations might lead to unexpected twists along the journey.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 卡牌搭建基础牌组、遗物决定流派、祝福强化属性，三层资源共同应对能力各异的敌人
hooks.excerpt: Construct your basic deck with cards, build your genre with relics, and strengthen your attributes with blessings. You will encounter enemies with different special abilities. Counter or be countered, it depends on your choice.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
